title: Software Engineer
desc: I build the tools that turn client data into print-ready PDFs, from a browser-based template editor to the Python engine that renders it.

highlights.title: Tech lead, Template Builder
highlights.body: A drag-and-drop editor, like a simple Canva, where university clients design their own report templates and get an exact PDF back. I lead development in Next.js, React and TypeScript, having written most of its ~48k lines and 140 test files, and I am now steering its move onto banjo.py so what you design is exactly what prints.

highlights.title: Contributor, banjo.py
highlights.body: banjo.py turns HTML into print-ready PDFs and will power Template Builder. In Python, I made it safe to run templates that clients write: a sandboxed Jinja2, file reads confined to the template folder, and an allowlist for the sites a template can load from.

highlights.title: Template Wiki, Mythos
highlights.body: Mythos is our Laravel platform for client reports. I built its Template Wiki, which turns each template’s Markdown docs into a searchable admin wiki that links template rule references automatically and notifies subscribers when a new template update has been released.

highlights.title: Tech Lead, Site Mailer project
highlights.body: Site Mailer turns a donor’s online financial report into a personalised printed mailer with a QR code to their own page. I lead the project to make it repeatable for every client: planning epics and sprints, porting the legacy PHP data processors to JavaScript, and shipping the first campaign, a university donor tri-fold, to print.

title: Artificial Intelligence Instructor
desc: Led weekly sessions for 20+ students at Stanford, Berkeley and San Francisco State, teaching deep learning, computer vision and neural networks. Wrote lecture materials and hands-on coding projects in Python, Java, Matplotlib and Keras, and worked with camp staff to turn feedback into improvements for students and camp operations.

title: Supplemental Instruction Leader
desc: Ran weekly study sessions for historically difficult CS courses, writing coding assessments and lecture material in Python, Java and C. Graded 100+ CS1 and CS2 assignments a week, from multithreaded Python to memory management in C, with detailed feedback on memory use, runtime, code structure and documentation.
